title: [H-01] Swapped Tokens During `finalize()` Permanently Stuck in `DaosLive` Due to Missing Withdrawal Mechanism
summary: This bug report highlights an issue where swapped tokens are permanently stuck in the `DaosLive.sol` contract due to the lack of a mechanism to retrieve them. This can have a high impact as the tokens become inaccessible forever. The recommendation is to implement a withdrawal or sweep function in the contract to retrieve these tokens, or to make the recipient parameter configurable. The team has fixed the issue.
